Theorem 3.13 gives TRAE strong error O(delta_n^(2 min{beta,1}/(1+min{beta,1}))) and weak error O(delta_n^2) under its closeness and critical-radius conditions.

Theorem 12 gives misspecified RDIV squared-L2 error with stochastic, Tikhonov-bias, target approximation, and learned-density/operator terms; Section 8 selects candidate RDIV models by validation regularized loss.
